title: Grateful Dead Live at Feyline Field on 1973-11-25
lineage: MSR> Cass.> DATs> CDRs> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: A near‑perfect Sacks soundboard of the scorching 11/25/73 desert show, highlighted by a smoking Eyes of the World and an unforgettable China Cat > I Know You Rider jam.
ai_review.review: This Sacks‑transferred soundboard captures one of late‑’73’s most electrifying outdoor concerts with crystal‑clear vocals and no tin‑can muddiness. Jerry’s guitar is on fire throughout, the band rides a tight Weather Report Suite into an epic Eyes of the World, and the China Cat → Rider jam is repeatedly called “the best ever.” The recording quality is praised as near perfect, making the desert ambience and crowd energy shine.

ai_rating.rationale: All but one review give 5‑star praise; comments consistently note outstanding performance and excellent Sacks soundboard transfer, giving strong confidence in a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Near‑perfect transfer (Sacks), crisp vocal clarity, no tin‑can effect typical of ’73 tapes; reviewers call it “top‑notch” and “outstanding.”

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A classic late‑’73 desert set with a tight first half, an explosive Weather Report Suite leading into a blazing second set; the crowd’s desert vibe and occasional sunbreak add to the magic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar “on fire” all night and vocal performance praised; noted for soaring slide solos on Row Jimmy and WRS.
band_member_comments.Phil: Devastating bass feedback at end of Playing in the Band, ad‑libs lyrics during I Know You Rider, overall powerful presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Spirited vocals, memorable “dig the sunset” comment, energetic contribution throughout.
